autoGenerated.description: DEPRECATED: no longer consulted. When tls.enabled is true the chart auto-generates TLS material implicitly (cert-manager when its API is detected, otherwise genCA self-signed). Suppress by setting tls.certificatesSecret. Slated for removal in 6.0.0.

create.description: DEPRECATED: no longer consulted. The chart auto-detects cert-manager and renders a Certificate when its API is present. Opt out by pre-creating a Secret and pointing tls.certificatesSecret at it. Slated for removal in 6.0.0.

autoGenerator.description: DEPRECATED: no longer consulted. Use tls.certManager.issuerRef.* for Issuer configuration. Slated for removal in 6.0.0.

implementation.description: Gateway implementation to render. Allowed values: "gateway-api" or "istio".

infrastructure.description: Optional Gateway data-plane infrastructure extension. Allowed values: "" (none) or "envoy" (renders an EnvoyProxy CR). Only applicable when implementation: gateway-api.

envoyProxy.description: EnvoyProxy ownership knobs, consumed when gateway.infrastructure: envoy.
